subject.title: fix(agents): resume interrupted turns without a recognized abort string

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled restart-recovery change merge after direct runtime evidence confirms the persisted-abort invariant and tool restrictions?
rationale: The implementation changes persisted-session recovery semantics, and the available evidence is strong test coverage but not an observed after-fix gateway restart. The protected label requires explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Request restart evidence
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal/log or recording that shows an interrupted worker-abort tail, a gateway restart, successful continuation, and restricted handling of any dangling side-effecting tool call.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused tests and CI if maintainers already consider the restart-marking invariant sufficiently established.
